applies_when: Observational cohort, case-control, or cross-sectional study
not_a_requirement_when: Not universally mandated for secondary expression visualizations
what_to_document: Design, eligibility, source data, bias, missingness, estimates, sensitivity and limitations

applies_when: Genetic association study reported under STROBE
not_a_requirement_when: Not automatic for gene-expression heatmaps or model contrasts
what_to_document: Genotyping, stratification, missing genetic data, multiplicity, replication claims

applies_when: Prognostic tumor-marker study assessing patient outcomes
not_a_requirement_when: Not automatic for nonprognostic subtype descriptive effects
what_to_document: Patient selection, assay methods, endpoint, model and performance/uncertainty

not_a_requirement_when: Not automatically applicable to descriptive research without predictive model development or validation
what_to_document: Target, predictors, data splits, validation, model performance, fairness and transparency

applies_when: Computational tool or data-driven study submitted to Nature Communications
not_a_requirement_when: Not a universal rule for other journals
what_to_document: Custom code, versions, tests, data inputs and reproducing figures
